shortDescription: Hosts the dashboard home and user profile overview views with local view-state switching.
fullDescription: Renders two independent presentational views from one route using local state: a dashboard-home default state with interactive date filters, metric cards, a summary chart, and recent activity; and a user-profile-overview default state with a GitHub-style profile header, interactive repository tabs, searchable pinned repositories, and a contribution heatmap with selectable years. The route preserves both views in the active implementation instead of replacing earlier delivered UI with the newest screen.
